claims.text: The resort is in La Fortuna, Costa Rica, directly north of the Arenal Volcano.

findings.quote: La Fortuna, Costa Rica, directly north of the Arenal Volcano

claims.text: The resort has a view of the Arenal Volcano and natural hot springs.

findings.quote: With a spectacular view of the Arenal Volcano, natural hot springs

claims.text: Hot springs, pools and waterfalls are spread across the property, some tucked into the jungle and others connected to a swim-up bar.

findings.quote: There are over two dozen hot springs, pools, and waterfalls spread across the
some tucked away in the jungle, others connected to a swim-up bar

claims.text: The water in the hydrothermal pools rises naturally from volcanic magma far below ground.

findings.quote: The water in our artesian, hydrothermal pools emerges naturally from volcanic magma thousands of feet below

claims.text: Every guest room, suite and villa has a private terrace or balcony with a view of the volcano.

findings.quote: Each Guest Room, Suite, and Villa at The Springs Resort & Spa includes a Private Terrace and/or Balcony to enjoy our famous, picturesque view of the Volcano.

claims.text: Rooms are equipped with hammocks, rocking chairs, minibars and marble bathrooms with Jacuzzi tubs.

findings.quote: The rooms are equipped with Hammocks, Rocking Chairs, Minibars and Luxurious Marbled Bathrooms with Jacuzzi Tubs.

claims.text: The Sanctuary Spa uses the resort's own thermal mineral springs in its therapies.

findings.quote: At The Sanctuary Spa we take these natural gifts from our own thermal mineral springs and offer them to our guests through therapies

claims.text: The Sanctuary Spa takes up one entire level of the reception building.

findings.quote: Spa encompasses one entire level of our reception building

claims.text: Club Rio offers river tubing, river kayaking, horseback riding, a climbing and rappelling wall, an animal sanctuary, guided nature hikes, fishing and hot springs.

findings.quote: Club Rio Outdoor Center offers River Tubing, River Kayaking, Horseback Riding, Climbing and Rappelling Wall, Animal Sanctuary, Guided Nature Hikes, Fishing and Hot Springs.

claims.text: The horseback ride crosses the Arenal River and gallops through mountain meadows facing the Arenal Volcano.

findings.quote: this ride combines scenic forest trails, a crossing through the Arenal River and a gallop in the mountain meadows fronting the magnificent Arenal Volcano.

claims.text: A guided night walk through the jungle looks for tree frogs, scorpions and two-toed sloths.

findings.quote: go on the guided night walk tour through the jungle to see tree frogs, scorpions, and two-toed sloths

claims.text: The chef uses organic fruits and vegetables grown for the resort on neighboring farms.

findings.quote: organic fruits and vegetables grown specifically for us on neighboring farms

claims.text: Club Rio Outdoor Center sits below the resort along a forested, mile-long stretch of Arenal River frontage.

findings.quote: Club Rio Outdoor Center is located directly below the resort along our beautifully forested, mile long stretch of Arenal River frontage.

claims.text: With Costa Rica's Ministry of Environment and Energy, the resort runs a preserve for wildlife confiscated from poachers or donated by reserves, rescue centers or individuals.

findings.quote: In conjunction with the MINAE (Ministry of Environment and Energy) we operate a preserve for Costa Rican wildlife that have been confiscated from poachers or donated by other private reserves, rescue centers or individuals.

claims.text: The Honeymoon Vista Guest Room has a garden terrace with a private hot spring-fed Jacuzzi.

findings.quote: This unique First-Floor room type features a garden terrace with a Private Hot Spring-Fed Jacuzzi

claims.text: Las Hojas Spa Bungalow is in a river canyon surrounded by several hot springs and creeks.

findings.quote: You will enter a heavenly river canyon surrounded by several hot springs and creeks.
Please come join us at Las Hojas Spa Bungalow

claims.text: La Laguna swim-up bar sits in the center of the largest lagoon pool, which has infinity-edge waterfalls facing the volcano.

findings.quote: This is our ever-popular swim up bar that is located in the center of our largest lagoon pool.
has infinity edge waterfalls fronting the volcano

claims.text: Club Rio is about a mile from the main lobby, reached by a shuttle that runs every half hour.

findings.quote: located one mile from the main lobby with shuttles running back and forth every half hour

claims.text: Club Rio has no lifeguards or babysitters, so parents must supervise children there.

findings.quote: We do not have lifeguards or babysitters
Children 16 and under must be accompanied and monitored by an adult at all times on the grounds of Club Rio.

claims.text: Room rates do not include breakfast or other meals.

findings.quote: All rates DO NOT include breakfast, any other meals, or sales tax (13%).
